scope: R06 composition sensitivity, all 26 Fields, all ten fixed models
eligibility: Iteratively retain Subfields having at least ceil(410/G) papers in each period, until G stabilizes. Same retained set for observed and equal composition.
paired_sampling: One random ordering per Field/Subfield/period/repetition; quotas differ, model IDs identical. Observed condition uses uniform sampling from eligible rows, preserving period quota.
interpretation: Controlled composition within the eligible observed corpus, not causal attribution. Report exclusion coverage, all repetitions, and single-Subfield Fields explicitly.
